theory.title: Not only…but also y both…and
theory.explanation: Usa not only…but also para añadir un segundo aspecto, a menudo sorprendente. Usa both…and para unir dos ideas equivalentes. Cuando not only aparece al principio de una oración, el inglés formal puede utilizar inversión: Not only did they refund me, but they also apologised (no solo me reembolsaron, sino que también se disculparon).
theory.tip: Not only… but also añade énfasis; both…and une dos elementos equivalentes.

patterns.label: Not only…but also y both…and · 1
patterns.pattern: The service was not only quick but also friendly.
examples:
The service was not only quick but also friendly.
→ El servicio no solo fue rápido, sino también amable.

patterns.label: Not only…but also y both…and · 2
patterns.pattern: Both the price and the quality were excellent.
examples:
Both the price and the quality were excellent.
→ Tanto el precio como la calidad fueron excelentes.

patterns.label: Not only…but also y both…and · 3
patterns.pattern: Not only did they replace the item, but they also refunded the delivery fee.
examples:
Not only did they replace the item, but they also refunded the delivery fee.
→ No solo sustituyeron el artículo, sino que también devolvieron el coste del envío.

patterns.label: Not only…but also y both…and · 4
patterns.pattern: Both online shops and local stores offer discounts.
examples:
Both online shops and local stores offer discounts.
→ Tanto las tiendas en línea como las tiendas locales ofrecen descuentos.

patterns.label: Not only…but also y both…and · 5
patterns.pattern: The product is not only useful but also affordable.
examples:
The product is not only useful but also affordable.
→ El producto no solo es útil, sino también asequible.

patterns.label: Not only…but also y both…and · 6
patterns.pattern: Both customers and staff agreed with the change.
examples:
Both customers and staff agreed with the change.
→ Tanto los clientes como el personal estuvieron de acuerdo con el cambio.

patterns.label: Not only…but also y both…and · 7
patterns.pattern: Not only was the delivery late, but the package was damaged too.
examples:
Not only was the delivery late, but the package was damaged too.
→ No solo llegó tarde el pedido, sino que el paquete también estaba dañado.

patterns.label: Not only…but also y both…and · 8
patterns.pattern: Both the warranty and the receipt are important.
examples:
Both the warranty and the receipt are important.
→ Tanto la garantía como el recibo son importantes.

patterns.label: Not only…but also y both…and · 9
patterns.pattern: The company not only listened but also took action.
examples:
The company not only listened but also took action.
→ La empresa no solo escuchó, sino que también actuó.

patterns.label: Not only…but also y both…and · 10
patterns.pattern: Both saving and spending require planning.
examples:
Both saving and spending require planning.
→ Tanto ahorrar como gastar requiere planificación.

content.passage: A local shop received excellent feedback after changing its customer service. The new system was not only quicker but also easier to use. Both customers and staff liked the clearer information. Not only did the shop reduce waiting times, but it also improved its refund process. The manager believes that both fair prices and reliable service are important for long-term success.

items.prompt: Describe a service that was not only quick but also friendly.
items.modelAnswer: I used a repair service that was not only quick but also friendly. The technician explained the problem, replaced a small part and returned my bicycle the same afternoon. I would use the service again.

items.prompt: Compare two things using both…and.
items.modelAnswer: Both price and quality matter when I buy household equipment. A cheap product may cost more in the long term if it breaks quickly, so I compare the warranty and customer reviews too.

items.prompt: Talk about a company that not only listened but also acted.
items.modelAnswer: The phone company not only listened to my complaint but also acted quickly. They checked the bill, corrected the extra charge and sent me an updated statement. I was pleased with the way they handled it.

items.prompt: Explain why both price and quality matter.
items.modelAnswer: Price and quality are both important because customers want something that works well and offers good value. The cheapest option is not always the best if it needs replacing soon.

items.prompt: Describe a product that is not only useful but also affordable.
items.modelAnswer: I bought a reusable lunch box that is not only useful but also affordable. It keeps food fresh, fits in my bag and is easy to clean. I use it almost every day.

items.prompt: Talk about a change that improved both customer and staff experience.
items.modelAnswer: The new online booking system improved both the customer and staff experience. Customers can choose a time without waiting on the phone, and staff can see the schedule more clearly.

items.prompt: Give an example using not only did… but also.
items.modelAnswer: Not only did the shop replace the faulty item, but it also refunded the delivery cost. I thought that was excellent customer service because they recognised the inconvenience.

items.prompt: Explain why both saving and spending need planning.
items.modelAnswer: Saving and spending both need planning. I set aside money for regular bills and try to save a small amount each month. I also leave some money for activities I enjoy.

items.prompt: Recommend a shop using two positive points.
items.modelAnswer: I recommend the local bookshop because the staff are knowledgeable and the prices are reasonable. It not only sells a wide range of books but also organises events for readers.

items.prompt: Make five sentences with not only…but also and both…and.
items.modelAnswer: The repair was not only fast but also reliable. Both the price and the service were fair. Not only did the assistant explain the options, but she also helped me choose the best one.

content.audioTranscript: A: I'm calling about my order. B: Do you have the receipt? A: Yes. The customer service told me I could get a refund. B: Was there a problem with the delivery? A: Yes, so I asked to speak to the manager. B: I'll contact the supplier and check the payment. A: Thank you. Is the parcel going to the right address? B: Yes, it should arrive tomorrow.
